results.title: Queen’s University Belfast clears Jason Arday’s research after plagiarism probe
results.content: Research by former Cambridge professor Jason Arday has been cleared by Queen’s University Belfast, one of several institutions that investigated plagiarism allegations against him.

results.title: Kenyan starvation cult leader convicted of radicalisation
results.content: Kenyan preacher Paul Mackenzie has been convicted of radicalisation and organised criminal activity, barely a month after he was sentenced to 200 years in prison for the murders of children in the Shakahola starvation cult.

results.title: Egypt arrests driver accused of causing deadly Cairo fuel tanker crash
results.content: Egyptian authorities have arrested a driver accused of causing a fuel tanker to overturn.The accident on Wednesday on a busy ring road surrounding Cairo caused the death of 31 people and injured 26 others.

results.title: Armed men kill 13 guards in 'terrorist attack' in western Niger
results.content: Armed men on Thursday killed at least 13 Nigerien guards in an attack in the restive Tillaberi region in western Niger, the defence ministry said in a statement.

results.title: UN says global maritime trade projected to record zero growth in 2026
results.content: The UN trade and development agency says geopolitical uncertainty is disrupting major shipping routes and chokepoints, forcing vessels to undertake longer and more expensive journeys.

results.title: Iran denies involvement in Kuwait strike that killed two Italians
results.content: Iran’s foreign minister has denied his country was responsible for the deaths of two Italians nationals killed in a strike on Kuwait.

results.title: Pix of the Day, 27th November 2026: Kenyan DJ wows crowds on Nairobi’s streets
results.content: At 29 years old, Deejay Boboss entertains Nairobi passersby with his homemade wooden DJ deck. A radio repairer himself, Boboss put his self-taught electronic skills to use to build his own functional music deck.

results.title: Video shows Levski fan caught giving Nazi salute before Marseille match
results.content: Violent clashes marred Marseille’s Europa League win over Levski Sofia, with a filmed Nazi salute, flares, injuries and condemnation from both presidents.

results.title: Cuba honours Fidel Castro on 10th anniversary of his death
results.content: Hundreds of people gathered in front of Cuba’s University of Havana on Thursday to honor former leader Fidel Castro on the tenth anniversary of his death. The commemoration comes as Cuba faces a severe economic crisis due to US sanctions and an oil embargo.

results.title: South Sudan's president lifts state of emergency in four regions ahead of polls
results.content: Salva Kiir has lifted a state of emergency in four regions, state TV reported on Thursday. The move comes ahead of the country's much-delayed first general elections since independence in 2011, now scheduled for February 2027.

results.title: Egypt's Sisi and Qatar's Sheikh Tamim discuss Palestine, regional stability
results.content: Qatar’s Emir Sheikh Tamim bin Hamad al Thani arrived in Cairo on Thursday for talks with Egypt's President Abdel Fattah el-Sisi. The meeting underscored the two nations’ alignment on Gaza, Palestinian statehood and regional stability.

results.title: Russia: Moscow's iconic Soviet-era expo park opens its 20,000-square-metre outdoor ice rink
results.content: Moscow's iconic VDNKh exhibition park has opened its vast outdoor ice rink for the winter season on Thursday 26 November 2026, welcoming skaters to 20,000 square metres of ice winding around the complex's landmark Soviet-era fountains.

results.title: Italy says not informed about Ukraine drone strike on Russian ships in Libya
results.content: Italy has joined the voices expressing concern about Ukraine’s attack on Russia ships in Libyan waters. Rome was not informed of Sunday’s drone strike, the country’s foreign minister told parliament on Thursday, warning that further military action could jeopardise efforts to reunify Libya.

results.title: Algeria condemns 'spillover' of Ukraine war into Libya
results.content: Algeria on Thursday condemned what it called the ‘spillover’ of the war in Ukraine into Libya, after Kyiv’s attack on two Russian vessels off eastern Libya. Two Libyan soldiers were killed in Sunday’s drone strikes which sank a Russian warship and targeted a cargo ship in Libyan waters.

results.title: Germany: Christmas markets open across the country amid tight security
results.content: Christmas markets across Germany are welcoming visitors with dazzling lights, traditional treats and festive attractions. Security remains a priority following deadly attacks in recent years.

results.title: Mali top Group G as Côte d’Ivoire join them in U-17 World Cup knockouts
results.content: Mali finished top of Group G with a perfect record after beating Vietnam 2-0 on Thursday, completing a three-match winning run to reach the knockout rounds of the FIFA U-17 World Cup.

results.title: Morocco and Senegal advance to U-17 World Cup knockout stage
results.content: Morocco’s Under-17 team secured a place in the round of 32 at the FIFA U-17 World Cup despite losing 2-1 to Spain in their final Group H match on Thursday. The Atlas Cubs finished second in the group with three points.

results.title: In Nigeria, ISWAP turns to armed drones and global financing networks
results.content: Armed drones, satellite communications and international financing network: Islamic State militants in Nigeria are stepping up their technological capabilities to sustain their insurgency.

results.title: UK: London's Gingerbread City returns with 50 edible architectural creations
results.content: London architects have created a miniature city featuring gingerbread skyscrapers, sugar rivers and iconic landmarks. The festive exhibition also explores the future of urban living.

results.title: Belgium: Farmers and tractors descend on Brussels to defend EU subsidies
results.content: Around 200 representatives of European farming unions marched through Brussels, Belgium, on Thursday 26 November 2026 to protest against proposed cuts to the European Union's Common Agricultural Policy (CAP). The demonstration coincided with a summit on the bloc's next long-term budget.

results.title: Guinea-Bissau delays elections for two years to 2028
results.content: Guinea-Bissau’s military rulers have pushed back presidential and parliamentary elections by two years, delaying the country’s promised return to civilian rule.

results.title: UN says Ebola outbreak driving spike in gender-based violence in DR Congo
results.content: In the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola outbreak is increasing the vulnerability of women and girls, exposing them to a rise in gender-based violence, according to UNICEF

results.title: Extreme heat threatens pregnant women in South Africa’s informal settlements
results.content: Inside an antenatal unit in Mamelodi south africa, expectant mothers are battling dizziness, swollen feet and exhaustion as temperatures soar. In nearby informal settlements, extreme heat is raising fears of premature births and putting maternal health at risk.

results.title: American artist showcases plants in YSL Marrakech Museum in Morocco
results.content: Fifty drawings, watercolours, oil paintings, and ink on paper pieces by Dan McCleary showcase the Majorelle Jardin's flora, at the Yves Saint Laurent Museum.

results.title: US-backed Ebola quarantine centre violated constitution, Kenyan court rules
results.content: A Kenyan court on Thursday ruled that the government had breached the constitution by allowing the construction of a US-backed Ebola quarantine site at a military base in Laikipia.

results.title: Italy's Meloni concerned after Ukraine attack on Russian ship in Libya
results.content: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni spoke in Brussels ahead of a European Union leaders’ meeting convened to discuss the bloc’s next long-term budget and a new loan to help Ukraine meet its economic and military needs

results.title: Egypt says 31 dead in Cairo fuel truck inferno, one man arrested
results.content: A fuel truck overturned on Wednesday, triggering a massive blaze that engulfed nearby vehicles. At least 31 people have been killed in the deadly fire. A man has been arrested in connection with the incident.

results.title: UN human rights chief warns of risk of escalating violence in western Nigeria
results.content: Dozens of people have been killed in a spate of attacks and reprisals linked to disputes betwen herders and farmers.

results.title: DRC–Uganda tensions escalate as Kinshasa summons Ugandan diplomat
results.content: Tensions are rising between the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda following controversial statements by Uganda’s army chief, General Muhoozi Kainerugaba.

results.title: Senegal parliament denounces president over budget decree
results.content: Senegal's parliament on Wednesday adopted a resolution criticizing President Bassirou Diomaye Faye's decision ​to implement a budget bill for 2026 that ‌lawmakers had previously rejected
